stem: Which question can scientists most likely answer from studying the fossil of the dinosaur?

options.label: A
options.text: What was the pattern on the skin of the dinosaur?

options.label: B
options.text: What was the type of food the dinosaur ate?

options.label: C
options.text: How fast was the heart of the dinosaur beating?

options.label: D
options.text: How many eggs were in the nest of the dinosaur?
